title: Concept: Nuxt DevTools overlay served
description: The DevTools overlay renders the Nuxt configuration and the runtime state, including the public runtime config that the application passes to the client. On a server-rendered page it also lists the server routes, which are the API surface.
applicability: Responses from a Nuxt deployment built with DevTools enabled.
risk: The caller reads the runtime configuration and the server route list, and inspects component state that may hold personal data.
